# Third-party packages

Recipes for dependencies that are not in the official Arch repositories, so Yui
doesn't depend on the AUR. They were copied from the AUR, reviewed, and are built
into the Yui package repository. Each one keeps its upstream license.

| Package | Upstream | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `quickshell-git` | git.outfoxxed.me/quickshell/quickshell | The Yui Shell needs features newer than the tagged release |
| `qt6-m3shapes-git` | github.com/soramanew/m3shapes | Material 3 Expressive shapes |
| `libcava` | github.com/LukashonakV/cava | Audio visualizer |
| `app2unit` | github.com/Vladimir-csp/app2unit | Launch apps as systemd units |
| `ttf-rubik-vf` | github.com/googlefonts/rubik | Shell font |
| `python-materialyoucolor` | github.com/T-Dynamos/materialyoucolor-python | Colors from the wallpaper |
| `hyprland-plugins` | github.com/hyprwm/hyprland-plugins | hyprbars title bars |
